handback.t:
ROUTER-ADDON (d4) finished. Only the shaper clears the bar. Abstain and calibration do not, and I report them as negatives.

**What I built (std-only, opt-in)**
- `src/addons.rs` has three add-ons that wrap any `Router`. The new `pub mod addons;` line in `src/lib.rs` is my only edit outside my own files.
  - **`Shaped<R: Router>` / `Shaper`:** turns the hook's tool-ok bit plus per-task proxies (retry count, latency, length) into a graded reward in [0,1]. It uses only signals present on every task, not X3's delayed reuse signal. Each channel gets a log transform, optional per-feature or per-agent mean removal, and z-normalisation. Channels are summed with fixed or label-free factor weights, and a hard tool failure gives reward 0.
  - **`Abstain<R>`:** `confidence(task, agent)` plus an abstain flag that falls back to the keyword agent.
  - **`ConfCalibrator`:** a tiny per-feature plus affine confidence calibration layer.
- Unit tests: 7, including off == passthrough for the shaper and for abstain. `cargo test --release --lib` gives 169 passed, 0 failed.
- `src/bin/d4_addons.rs` runs in about 15 s and is deterministic. Results are in `results/d4_addons.json` and `results/d4_addons_confirm61-90.json`.

**Protocol**
- I tuned on seeds 1-8 and evaluated held-out 31-60. Confirmation on 61-90 used the frozen tuning.
- Worlds are X3's weak-feedback sim (Fixed and Random scenarios) crossed with four observation models:
  - lat-only: X3's world unchanged.
  - rich: retries, latency and length all carry quality.
  - confounded: rich plus strong per-agent speed, style and retry-rate biases.
  - useless: the proxies are pure noise.
- Comparison is paired 95% t-CI, Holm over 96 tests, against the best raw-feedback baseline per (world, horizon). The baselines are keyword, eps-greedy, pooled-thompson, hebbian-robust, warm k1, warm k10 and guarded(hebr).

**Result: `shaped(guarded(hebr))` wins at H2000 in 4 of 6 informative worlds, always against keyword.**

| World | 31-60 | 61-90 (frozen) |
|---|---|---|
| fixed-rich | +0.0147 [+0.008,+0.021], Holm p=.004 | +0.0162 |
| fixed-confounded | +0.0137, p=.007 | +0.0168 |
| random-rich | +0.0281 [+0.019,+0.037], p<1e-4 | +0.0285 |
| random-confounded | +0.0224, p=.004 | +0.0224 |

- On 61-90 the same four wins hold, and there are two extra H500 wins in the fixed worlds against guarded(hebr), +0.006 and +0.008.
- shaped(guarded) has no Holm losses on 31-60. On 61-90 its only loss is -0.0037 at H250 in random-lat-only (p=.014).
- The tuned parameters are center 0.6, gain 0.2, equal channel weights, no per-agent debias.

**Negatives**
- **Latency alone:** in X3's lat-only world there is no gain (+0.0004 at H2000, n.s.). That confirms X3: latency cannot be shaped into a usable signal.
- **Ungated learners:** shaped(hebbian-robust) loses by 0.05 to 0.28 against keyword in every world. shaped(warm k1) loses by 0.02 to 0.05. Shaping does not rescue a learner without the confidence-gated front.
- **Useless proxies:** shaped(guarded) is -0.001 to -0.002 vs keyword, n.s., so the gate keeps it safe.
- **Horizon:** gains appear only at H2000 (plus H500 on 61-90). H100 and H250 are not significant.
- **Label-free factor weighting:** it did not beat equal weights. Tuning picked it off, and turning it on costs 0.005 to 0.009 in rich worlds. It is only safer in the useless world, by +0.003.
- **Per-agent debias:** it costs about 0.01 because it removes real agent-quality differences.
- **Abstain:**
  - Confidence is informative as a ranking. In rich worlds, selective risk is 0.19 at 25% coverage against 0.31 at full coverage. In normal worlds it is 0.15 against 0.23.
  - Abstaining does not raise success of the best candidate. On shaped(guarded) the change is under 0.002 and n.s. in the weak worlds, and -0.015 (p=.014) in n-random at 8% abstain.
  - On the shaped(warm) base abstain gains about 0.01 to 0.02, but that base stays below keyword, so I make no claim.
- **Calibration layer:** no help. Normal-world ECE is unchanged (0.037 to 0.038/0.036), and it is mixed in weak worlds (0.14 to 0.19 for warm, 0.14 to 0.13 for guarded). Not claimed.
- **No-harm control:** with outcome feedback the shaper is bit-identical to the bare router (max |diff| 0).

**Caveats**
- The world is my construction, and the proxies are built to carry quality. The win needs an informative absolute channel, such as retries independent of task type.
- The effect is a few points at long horizon.

**Warning for HEAD:** when I checked, `src/lib.rs` had lost the `pub mod coupling;` line, apparently overwritten by another worker. I only re-added my own line, and `x3_coupling` will not build without that one.
